fieldNotes.site: Ball operates a ~712,000 sq ft aluminum can-body plant on the integrated Red Bull / Rauch / Ball campus at the SE corner of Reems Rd & Peoria Ave (Woolf Logistics Campus), Glendale AZ. Started up Q1 2021. Cans move by a 280-ft conveyor bridge to the adjacent Red Bull/Rauch FILLING hall, then a 418-ft bridge to the 'Project Lagerhaus' distribution warehouse. The three buildings form a connected chain.
fieldNotes.buildingAttribution: Audited building = the center manufacturing hall (the chain's process building): heavy rooftop process equipment + a large on-site electrical switchyard (can body-making is very power-intensive) + its own trailer staging and dock bank. This is the building the 'Ball Metal Beverage Container Glendale' address geocodes to (15102 W Peoria Ave). Building-level attribution on a shared, bridge-connected campus is medium confidence: the west warehouse box and the south solar-roof distribution building are the fill/Lagerhaus partners.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Campus is gated (screen walls + controlled entry drive off Peoria Ave visible in Street View); a small booth-like structure sits at the entrance. Guard vs kiosk not fully resolvable from imagery/road view — flagged.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of 3+ connected large buildings (Ball can plant, Red Bull/Rauch fill, Lagerhaus distribution) plus neighboring tenants.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur; desert edge-of-metro site, all-truck plus the internal conveyor bridges.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Far NW edge of the Phoenix metro (Glendale/Waddell) inside an active master-planned industrial park with adjacent residential subdivisions; classed Urban (metro fabric), though farmland abuts to the south/east.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimated ~16 external dock doors (south hall NE face + east yard); most can output leaves by internal conveyor bridge, so external docks are modest for the building size.

citations.claim: Ball's own Feb-2025 global locations map lists Glendale (AZ) as an operating site; Phoenix and St. Paul (closed plants) are absent.
Ball Corporation named as building the can plant on the Glendale Reems/Peoria campus; plant started Q1 2021.

verification.rationale: Ball's 2021-startup Glendale can-body plant is current per Ball's own 2025 locations map; the Ball AZ plant that closed was the older Phoenix site, not Glendale (which Ball was ramping up).
